summary: Disc Medicine filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to $189,925,765 of common stock (Nasdaq: IRON) sold through TD Cowen as sales agent or principal, dated November 5, 2026, off an automatic Form S-3 shelf. Reference price was $83.28 (November 4, 2026 close). TD Cowen earns up to 3.0% of gross proceeds; no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution and the pace of ATM usage against clinical catalysts and cash runway; no deal terms or premium apply.
